raw_record.question_text: $\triangle K L N$ and $\triangle L M N$ are isosceles and $m \angle J K N=130$. Find the measure of $\angle LNM$.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram: in triangle LMN, LM and MN have matching double tick marks, so those sides are equal. The 20° label is the angle at L between LN and LM. Since LM = MN, triangle LMN is isosceles with base LN, so its base angles at L and N are equal. Therefore ∠LNM = ∠NLM = 20°.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中右侧是三角形 LMN，边 LM 和边 MN 上有相同的双刻痕，表示 LM = MN。点 L 处，射线 LN 与 LM 之间的角标为 20°。
推理：因为 LM = MN，所以 △LMN 是以 LN 为底边的等腰三角形，底角在 L 和 N 处相等。因此 ∠LNM = ∠NLM。图中 ∠NLM = 20°，所以 ∠LNM = 20°。
